strings.name: David Beckham
strings.summary: Raised in London, Beckham debuted for Manchester United in 1992 and helped win the 1999 treble before playing for Madrid, Galaxy and PSG. Known for crossing and free kicks, he captained England. After retirement he helped build Inter Miami and supported UNICEF, while his Qatar promotional role drew human-rights criticism. Knighted in 2025, he was elected to the US Soccer Hall in 2026; induction remained pending.
strings.influence.rationale: England international and football club investor, connecting competitive sport with global commercial culture.
strings.facts.f2.value: Attended Chingford school; trained in Manchester United’s youth system.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Crosses and set pieces
strings.highlights.h1.text: Contributed to league titles through right-sided passing and free-kick technique.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Clubs and children’s work
strings.highlights.h2.text: Helped build Inter Miami and has served as UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador since 2005.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Elected to US Soccer Hall
strings.timeline.t1.text: Selected for the class of 2027; induction had not occurred by the factual cutoff.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Knighted
strings.timeline.t2.text: Received a knighthood at Windsor Castle for football and charity.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Miami club approved
strings.timeline.t3.text: His Miami expansion project gained MLS approval; the team began play in 2020.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Retired from playing
strings.timeline.t4.text: Retired after PSG, turning to club ventures and public activities.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Joined LA Galaxy
strings.timeline.t5.text: Moved to MLS, increasing the league’s international visibility.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joined Real Madrid
strings.timeline.t6.text: Left United for Madrid, later winning La Liga in 2007.
strings.timeline.t7.title: United treble
strings.timeline.t7.text: Helped win the Premier League, FA Cup and Champions League treble.
strings.timeline.t8.title: United first-team debut
strings.timeline.t8.text: Made his United debut at 17, progressing into senior professional football.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Born in London
strings.timeline.t9.text: Born in Leytonstone and grew up in London’s football environment.
